tokens.name: bliss
tokens.usage: The ground of every screen in both modes. Faintly lavender; never pure white at page level.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the top bar, the Cypher panel. Sits on bliss.

tokens.name: surface-quiet
tokens.usage: A quieter well inside a surface: Cypher's inline recommendation, the status block, inputs.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, dividers. Never text.

tokens.name: mist-2
tokens.usage: Table row dividers, progress tracks, the quietest line.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body text, the shell, primary buttons, the resting and watching eye.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Raised surface inside the shell: the project switcher, the stream readout.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Lines inside the shell and inactive icon squares.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary body text on surface or bliss. 9.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, timestamps, placeholders. 5.0:1 on white, 4.7:1 on bliss; never below 13px.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink, ink-2 and every team hue.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav labels and secondary text on ink. 9.1:1 on ink.

tokens.name: on-ink-quiet
tokens.usage: The quietest text on ink: settings, the stream readout keys. 5.6:1 on ink.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The eye when it needs a word, the halo, dots. Graphic only: never text on white.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral as text or as a filled control with white text: Yours labels, clocks, blocked states, the Yours badge. 4.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: A project tile or row that has something yours in it; the directive-applying well.

tokens.name: coral-halo
tokens.usage: The breathing halo behind the eye when something is yours.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done, passed, handled, live. Checkmarks and pass chips. 4.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: Discovery: avatars, phase segments, pills raised by Discovery. Also the user avatar. White text passes at 5.1:1.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Engineering: avatars, phase segments, progress bars on Engineering work. White text passes at 4.9:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Content: avatars, phase segments, migration metrics. White text passes at 5.2:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Quality: avatars, phase segments, QA metrics; also the waiting state. White text passes at 5.2:1.

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: A warning row in a log or table.

tokens.name: iris-tint
tokens.usage: Forecast bars in charts and quiet Discovery-tinted surfaces.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon-to-text inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; between a type pill and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm inside a card; gap between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; panel padding in Everything.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in Bliss; main padding in Everything.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in Everything.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in Bliss; gap between the eye and the sentence.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main padding in Bliss.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: A table row, a list row, a nav item with its padding. Nothing shorter than 44 is tappable.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The Bliss rail.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The Everything sidebar.

tokens.name: launcher
tokens.usage: The Cypher button, fixed 24px from the bottom and right edges of every Everything screen.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The Cypher sheet that opens above the button; up to 720px tall, then it scrolls. It overlays content and never docks.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: The top bar in Everything.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the Bliss canvas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Initials tiles, small avatars that are squares, chips inside the shell.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nav items, project switcher, rail items, KPI tiles' inner wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels in Everything; Cypher's inline recommendation well.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and project tiles in Bliss.

tokens.name: radius-xxl
tokens.usage: The one decision card on Mission Control.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, the dial, search, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card that is yours in Bliss. Everything else uses a mist border and no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-decision
tokens.usage: The one decision card on Mission Control.
